items.name: False-Light Lantern Charm
items.lore: A little glass ball with a sheerie's light trapped in it. It lies about where it is.

items.name: Morning Star Ring
items.lore: Carved from the figurehead of a wrecked ship.

items.name: Driftwood Bracer
items.lore: Silver-grey wood that once walked the shore at night.

items.name: Widow's Shawl
items.lore: Black wool. Maeve wore it for three years.

items.name: Treaty-Stick Charm
items.lore: An ogham treaty-stick, mended with silver wire.

items.name: Eriu Fishing-Torc
items.lore: Bronze, twisted like rope, the way the eriu make everything.

items.name: Brehon's Ring
items.lore: A judge's ring. Aodh gave you his spare.

items.name: Orla's Woven Belt
items.lore: Eriu weaving, taught to Orla in captivity. She's better at it than they are.
